newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-GIDDINS DRUGS BAN APPEAL TURNED DOWN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-GIDDINS DRUGS BAN APPEAL TURNED DOWN.

text.p: Former Sussex bowler Ed Giddins on Friday lost his appeal against his 19-month ban for failing a drugs test.

The 25-year-old England A seamer, banned by the Test and County Cricket Board's disciplinary committee in August after testing positive for cocaine, had his plea rejected by the five-man Cricket Council Appeals' Committee.
Giddins, sacked by Sussex after failing the drugs test, was accompanied at Lord's by his legal team to put his case before the committee.
The hearing lasted just over two and a half hours before Giddins emerged to announce: "The appeal has been unsuccessful."
